εἰ , conjunctive particle , used in conditions and in indirect questions. __I. Conditional, if ; __1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; __(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mat.11:14 , Rom.8:25 , al.; before imperat., Mrk.4:23 9:22 , Jhn.15:18 , 1Co.7:9 , al.; before fut. indic., Luk.16:31 , Rom.8:11 , al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mat.12:26 , Rom.4:14 , al.; similarly, before impf., Luk.17:6 , Jhn.8:39 ; before quæst., Mat.6:23 , Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46 , 1Pe.2:20 ; __(b) fut.: Mat.26:33 , 1Pe.2:20 ; __(with) pf.: Jhn.11:12 , Rom.6:5 , al.; __(d) aor.: Luk.16:11 19:8 , Jhn.13:32, 18:23 , Rev.20:15 , al. __2. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition : Act.24:19 27:39 , 1Co.14:10 15:37 , I Pe3:14, 17. __II. Interrogative, if, whether . __1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63 , Mrk.15:36 , Act.19:2 , 2Co.13:5 , al.; fut., Mrk.3:2 , Act.8:22 , al.; aor., Mrk.15:44 , 1Co.1:16 , al.; with subjc. aor.
